What the model is weighing
• Main trade-off: Local demand and foot traffic in the balanced against Capital expenditure required to fit out
• Assumption to check: whether the model's key inputs reflect your real delivery constraints

Your brief was light on detail, so adding specifics will make the comparison more reliable.

Next, choose the missing effect value for "open a second bakery location in Leeds…" on "Operational capacity and staffing at th…" so the comparison can be prepared.

A few things to check: I've assumed the goal, the alternatives and the figures in this draft, and I haven't confirmed them with you.
1. What outcome would make this decision a success?
2. What alternatives are you weighing this against?
3. Roughly what scale is at stake — budget, headcount, or revenue?
You can answer here, or change them directly on the canvas.
